business_scope.primary_industry_name: Automated Algorithm Underwriting for Micro Consumer Loans

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman — National (Unitary) Jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction; registered office to be situated in Muscat Governorate
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — Civil Law codified Omani statutes with Islamic Sharia as a residual source of interpretation; commercial and corporate matters governed by Royal Decrees and regulatory practice aligned with GCC frameworks and Oman's FTA obligations
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Oman Free Trade Agreement (entered into force 1 January 2009; investment chapter with national treatment and ISDS protections)
India-Oman Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1997, with subsequent amending protocols)
Oman-Japan Double Taxation Agreement (signed 2019; entered into force 2020)
GCC Economic Agreement (2001) and Oman WTO commitments (2000)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: UBO and AML/CFT governance is anchored in: (i) Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (New Companies Law), Article 258 and Chapter on Beneficial Owner registers; (ii) MoCIIP Decision No. 162/2020 issuing the Rules on the Beneficial Ownership Register of commercial companies; (iii) Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (Law on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing), as amended by Royal Decree No. 31/2018 and repealed/replaced by Royal Decree No. 24/2024 (new AML/CFT Law promulgated May 2024); (iv) Ministerial Decision No. 48/2017 issuing the Executive Regulations of the AML/CFT Law; (v) Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT Rules applicable to banks, licensed non-bank lenders, and fintech institutions; and (vi) MoCIIP Commercial Register Executive Regulations requiring ongoing UBO updates on any ownership or control change.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — mandatory UBO register filed with MoCIIP and transmitted to the Central Bank of Oman, the Omani Financial Intelligence Unit, and competent prosecutorial/supervisory authorities; not a public or searchable register; intermediaries are bound by statutory confidentiality and professional secrecy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the sole shareholder's passport or national ID of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or consulate in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — origin-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation followed by Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization (Oman is not a Hague Apostille Convention member); Arabic translation and Oman Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation upon arrival

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Certificate of Good Standing of the corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — origin-country MFA/corporate registry authentication, then Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified board resolution / power of attorney authorizing incorporation and execution of SPC constitutional documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of residence or corporate secretary of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — notarial certification, origin-country MFA attestation, then Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements of the foreign parent or principal shareholder (for Central Bank of Oman capital adequacy and fit-and-proper review)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified public accountant / statutory auditor of the origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — auditor attestation, origin-country MFA authentication, and Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization; Arabic summary translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter on the foreign shareholder and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate bank of the shareholder in the origin country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — bank seal/notarization, origin-country MFA attestation, then Omani Embassy/Consulate legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory, risk-based, recurring screening of the sole shareholder, all directors, authorized signatories, UBOs, and connected relatives/close associates against: (1) OFAC SDN List; (2) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (3) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (4) UK OFSI consolidated list; (5) local designations issued by the Omani National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing; and (6) GCC terrorist-listing databases. PEP screening covers domestic and foreign PEPs, including Omani public officials, senior members of the armed forces, and executives of state-owned enterprises. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), board-approved risk acceptance, attested source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, and ongoing transaction monitoring are mandatory given the High_Risk_Special_License AML tier of the P2P micro-lending platform; new sanctions updates must be processed within 24 hours under CBO obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — 'Invest Easy' national digital registry (https://investeasy.gov.om) — Commercial Name Reservation and Commercial Registration modules
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Arabic is the mandatory statutory language of the trade name. The Latin-script (English) transliteration may be added as a subsidiary name and must phonetically mirror the Arabic name; material divergence is rejected. For a single-person company (SPC), the name must carry the SPC/LLC legal-form designation, must not duplicate or be confusingly similar to any registered or reserved name in the Commercial Register, and must not falsely suggest banking, payment, financing, insurance, investment, state, religious, military, or sovereign character.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Oman / Sultanate of Oman (requires explicit ministerial approval)
Islamic / Sharia (requires regulatory and Sharia-board approval)
International / Global (requires minimum-capital or regulatory threshold compliance)
Holding / Group (requires parent or affiliate authorization)
Charity / Non-Profit / Humanitarian (requires separate license approval)
Any political, religious-faith, offensive, or socially repugnant wording
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended by renewal payment before expiry; if the reserved name lapses, a new clearance application is required. On rejection: (1) within 30 days of the refusal, file a formal administrative appeal through the Invest Easy portal or by written petition to the MoCIIP Undersecretary for Commercial Affairs, stating grounds and annexing corrective documents; (2) where rejection stems from sector-sensitive tokens (e.g., 'Lending', 'Financing', 'Payment', 'P2P'), obtain a no-objection letter from the Central Bank of Oman and resubmit; (3) if refused again despite sectoral approval, escalate to the MoCIIP Grievance and Complaints Committee; (4) final recourse is an annulment action before the Muscat Administrative Court. During the appeal, a provisional amended name may be reserved to avoid incorporation delays.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the licensed P2P micro-lending platform: the Central Bank of Oman and MoCIIP require a substantive registered office and operating premises in Oman, including a lease in the SPC's name, physical records, management presence, and signage. A virtual or serviced mailbox is unacceptable as the registered office for CBO AML/CFT supervisory purposes. Auxiliary back-office functions may use serviced offices, but the licensed lending decision function must have a physical, auditable situs in Oman.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximately 75–85% probability within the first 12 months of incorporation: CBO conducts pre-licensing on-site visits and unannounced prudential and AML/CFT inspections; MoCIIP and the Omani Financial Intelligence Unit may also perform unannounced address verifications and, in serious cases, coordinated document seizures under the AML/CFT Law.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial name clearance application (Invest Easy) — single name check including similarity screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: MoCIIP — Commercial Registration Directorate (Invest Easy portal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: OMR 20 fixed fee per name reservation request

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SPC incorporation and initial Commercial Register (CR) registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory MoCIIP fee schedule: OMR 100 base registration fee plus OMR 0.500 per OMR 1,000 of declared capital (no minimum capital applies to the SPC)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register (UBO) initial filing and disclosure statement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: OMR 20 per UBO filing under MoCIIP Decision No. 162/2020

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the SPC Memorandum of Association, power of attorney, and shareholder resolutions (Arabic originals)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff per instrument/pages; prevailing market benchmark OMR 35–45 for the incorporation bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of four foreign due-diligence documents (passport copy, incumbency, bank reference, audited financials)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Omani Embassy/Consulate in the country of origin, preceded by origin-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization tariff approximately USD 150 per document under prevailing Omani consular fee schedules

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation and attestation of foreign corporate documentation (MOA support bundles, financial statements, licenses)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified legal translation bureau accredited by MoCIIP
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: fixed bundle price of approximately OMR 65–70 for the incorporation CDD set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Central Bank of Oman special license application fee for non-bank P2P micro-lending / automated underwriting platform
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Central Bank of Oman — Banking Supervision / FinTech Licensing Department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: CBO licensing tariff for specialized lending and fintech payment-adjacent licensees: approximately OMR 1,000 per application, non-refundable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office lease — first-year rent and security deposit for Muscat commercial premises (SPC-dedicated office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: OMR 1,200–1,800 per annum for SME-grade commercial office plus one-month security deposit

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External Omani counsel — incorporation, UBO, name-clearance and CBO pre-licensing advisory retainer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Omani law firm licensed with the Oman Lawyers Association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a foreign-owned licensed SPC fintech incorporation and license-readiness package: USD 3,500–5,000

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Omani Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019), Articles 28–43 (Single Person Company) and Articles 176–222 (managerial and shareholder governance); Commercial Register Law (Royal Decree No. 3/1975), as amended; Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) permitting 100% foreign ownership; Central Bank of Oman Banking Law (Royal Decree No. 120/2000, as amended by RD 39/2014) and AML Law (RD 30/2016) applicable to licensed lending activity.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry Department, through the Invest Easy online portal (investineasy.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (AoA) for a Single Person Company, together with the standard Commercial Registration application form and SPC shareholder declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Single Person Company under RD 18/2019; share capital is fixed in the AoA. However, the Central Bank of Oman (CBO) special lending license requires designated paid-up capital to be deposited and held in escrow with a licensed Omani bank, with an escrow certificate issued to the CBO prior to license grant.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. That the subscription of the sole shareholder to the share capital fixed in the Articles of Association be accepted and fully recorded in the shareholders' register. 2. That the registered office be established at the premises set out in the tenancy contract in Muscat Governorate, Sultanate of Oman. 3. That the paid-up capital be deposited with a licensed commercial bank, with the escrow certificate retained for licensing purposes. 4. That [Name] be and is hereby appointed Manager (Director) with full executive and banking authority. 5. That [Name] be appointed AML/CFT Compliance Officer. 6. That the Manager be authorized to complete commercial registration, Chamber enrolment, municipal and civil defense licensing, tax registration, and the Central Bank of Oman special license application. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Invest Easy portal (investineasy.gov.om), Company Name Reservation Service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create an Invest Easy account under the foreign investor profile, enter the SPC legal form, select ISIC 6499 as the proposed activity, and submit three alternative Arabic/English company names. Pay the nominal name reservation fee online and download the Name Reservation Certificate, valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
One-page business plan summarizing the P2P micro-lending platform
Completed name reservation application through Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is refused for similarity or public-order reasons, file alternative names within 10 business days; the first re-submission is exempt from additional state fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs – Notarization Department (Notary Public), Muscat.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend before the notary with the sole shareholder or a duly authorized attorney to execute the AoA in Arabic, with a certified English translation. The AoA must incorporate the SPC governance provisions of RD 18/2019 Articles 28–43, capital clauses, manager appointment, AML/CFT officer designation, and registered office address.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Certificate
Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Draft Articles of Association in Arabic and certified English translation
Letter of intent or draft tenancy contract for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises drafting objections, legal counsel prepares a supplementary amendment memorandum; the corrected AoA is re-attested within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Commercial Registry Department via Invest Easy.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized AoA and SPC declaration through Invest Easy, pay the statutory CR and publication fees, and obtain the Commercial Registration Certificate evidencing the SPC legal form and ISIC 6499 activity. The registry arranges publication of the incorporation notice in the Official Gazette.
required_dossiers: Notarized AoA
Name Reservation Certificate
Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Written consent of the appointed Manager
Bank certificate of paid-up capital deposit, if capital prescribed in the AoA
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried (e.g., activity description mismatch with ISIC 6499), file an electronic amendment within 7 business days through the Invest Easy 'Cases' module; no re-notarization is required for pure registry classification changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the CR certificate to the OCCI membership office, pay the annual membership fee based on capital, and obtain the Chamber Certificate evidencing OCCI registration, required for employee visas and bank facility opening.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Notarized AoA
Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Certified tenancy contract for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OCCI data mismatches the CR record, obtain a certified CR extract from MoCIIP and resubmit to OCCI on the same business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality – Licensing Directorate; Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Authenticate the tenancy contract at Muscat Municipality, submit the layout and location plans, and apply for the municipal commercial license for a 'fintech and digital lending office'. Concurrently, submit the premises fire-safety file to CDAA for inspection and obtain the Fire Safety Certificate.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Authenticated tenancy contract
Premises layout plan and location map
Landlord's no-objection certificate
Fire alarm and suppression system test certificate from a CDAA-approved supplier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CDAA or municipal inspection lists deficiencies, complete the rectification works and schedule a re-inspection within 14 days; municipal objections are appealable to the Municipality Licensing Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with the Oman Tax Authority (OTA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register for Corporate Income Tax (15% on taxable profits) using the CR certificate and AoA, obtain a Tax Card, and register for VAT if projected taxable annual supplies exceed OMR 38,500; otherwise register for VAT voluntarily to facilitate input recovery and payment-rail compliance.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Notarized AoA
Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Bank certificate of account opening
Certified tenancy contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA queries missing attachments, upload the required documents through the e-Services case file within 7 days; a late response is cured by an administrative resubmission without penalty within the same month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Central Bank of Oman Special License for P2P Micro-Lending Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Bank of Oman – Banking Supervision Department / Fintech Licensing Unit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend a pre-application orientation meeting with CBO, then submit the full special license application under the CBO digital financial services and AML/CFT regulatory framework. Provide the complete AML/CFT compliance program, cybersecurity and technology risk policies, third-party payment rail agreements (ACH/direct debit and local wallets), fit-and-proper declarations, escrow certificate, and an independent compliance audit of the lending algorithm and platform.
required_dossiers: CBO prescribed license application form
Comprehensive business plan and feasibility study for P2P micro-lending
AML/CFT policy and internal controls manual
Cybersecurity and operational risk framework aligned with CBO/BCBS guidance
Outsourcing and payment-rail agreements (ACH direct debit, local wallet payout)
Fit-and-proper declarations for the sole shareholder, Manager, and AML appointed officers
Escrow certificate of designated paid-up capital from a licensed Omani bank
Independent compliance audit report of the IT underwriting platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CBO issues a deficiency list, respond within 30 working days with corrective documentation; if the license is formally denied, submit an administrative appeal to the CBO Executive President within 15 days, or present a revised application addressing the stated supervisory concerns.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) – Fintech Licensing Unit, in coordination with MoCIIP for the commercial license and the Oman Tax Authority for fiscal registration; AML/CFT supervision is exercised by the CBO Financial Intelligence Unit pursuant to Royal Decree No. 30/2016.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Non-Bank Micro-Lending and P2P Lending Platform License (Special License — High-Risk Category) issued under the CBO Banking Law RD 120/2000 and applicable CBO fintech and AML/CFT circulars.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 (Minor Project) Registration — office-based fintech activity is exempt from a full EIA report; an Environmental Registration Certificate is issued through the Environment Authority's e-services portal under RD 114/2001 and its Executive Regulation (Ministerial Decision 179/2001).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Omani Standard OS 8 for treated wastewater discharge (pH 6.5–8.5, BOD5 ≤ 25 mg/L, COD ≤ 150 mg/L, TSS ≤ 25 mg/L) where any on-site treatment exists; segregated non-hazardous office waste and e-waste (IT assets, servers, batteries) may only be handled by Environment Authority-licensed recyclers; emergency generator emissions, if installed, must meet Omani ambient air quality standards; CFC-free HVAC refrigerants only.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) verifying alarm, suppression, extinguisher, and exit compliance; structural load and occupancy clearance via Muscat Municipality's building completion/Occupancy Certificate; workplace clearance from the Ministry of Labour confirming compliance with Labor Law RD 35/2003, working hours, and ergonomic/IT workplace safety; Public Assembly License required if a client-facing branch office is opened.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), established under Royal Decree 38/2023 in succession to the Ministry of Finance's Secretariat General of Taxation; national e-services and filing portal: 'Taxoman'.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the SPC and obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion. 2) Register online on Taxoman using the CR data and obtain the unified Tax Registration Number (TRN) covering both Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009, as amended) and VAT Law (Royal Decree 121/2020). 3) Foreign non-resident owners must file the corporate CR/TIN application through a licensed national tax representative in Oman before making taxable supplies. 4) Submit MOA, board resolutions, lease agreement, proof of registered office and FATCA/CRS self-certification; the OTA issues an electronic tax-registration certificate. Registration must precede invoice issuance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman has no check-the-box, pass-through or explicit hybrid-mismatch election for SPCs. The SPC is mandatorily an entity-level taxpayer. Statutory elections are limited to: (i) tax-group consolidation for 100% owned Omani subsidiaries; (ii) carry-forward of tax losses to offset future taxable profits (subject to continuity and disclosure); (iii) small-business/SME incentive exemption claims; and (iv) choice of accelerated depreciation or investment incentive methods where regulation allows. No transparent classification is available for foreign-owned Omani SPCs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration when the value of taxable supplies exceeds OMR 38,500 (approx. USD 100,000) in any 12-month period; voluntary registration from OMR 19,250 (approx. USD 50,000). Non-resident suppliers of electronically supplied services to Oman have a separate physical-presence exception and may be captured by reverse charge even below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT Law requires a tax invoice (16 mandatory fields, TRN of supplier/receiver) or simplified invoice, issued within one month of the supply, with reverse-charge annotations for imported services. Oman does not currently operate mandatory real-time fiscal clearance, API e-invoice stamping or digital stamping; returns are submitted through Taxoman, and the OTA may require pre-clearance of high-risk export invoices and structured e-ledgers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: zero-rated when physically exported from Oman within 90 days of the tax invoice, evidenced by customs exit declarations and transport documents. Services: zero-rated when supplied to a recipient located outside Oman and the benefit is received outside Oman, including fintech underwriting and software-as-a-service supplied to non-resident platform clients. Interest margins and credit-granting services to Omani borrowers are exempt financial supplies, not zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (single administrative document or e-export manifest)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill proving physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT payment evidence to the Omani SPC
Zero-rated tax invoice annotated with export and TRN references
Exported-service contract with non-resident recipient and place-of-supply analysis
Algorithm-consumption log/loan ledger substantiating offshore performance of the micro-lending platform
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA may audit up to five prior tax years. For fraudulent zero-rating (false export declarations or sham offshore recipients), the OTA will claw back the 5% VAT previously zero-rated, impose statutory late-payment fines capped at 100% of the unpaid tax, levy a tax-evasion penalty of up to 100% of evaded tax plus administrative fines, and may refer the operator to the National Centre for Financial Information for anti-money-laundering investigation, with potential suspension or revocation of the TRN and e-services credentials.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), acting under the Banking Law and implementing the Sultanate's foreign exchange administration; investment licensing is coordinated with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial is pegged to the US dollar and is fully convertible for current account transactions. Capital account inflows are liberalized for registered foreign investments, including 100% foreign-owned SPCs, subject to bank-level compliance and the underlying investment license. Dividend and profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is permitted without exchange control license, but banks require audited financial statements, proof of tax compliance (tax clearance certificate where applicable), and full traceability of the source funds. The material practical hurdles are not convertibility but AML/KYC documentation and the classification of the payment purpose as investment capital or operating remittance. The Central Bank of Oman does not maintain discretionary approval for ordinary profit repatriation, provided the platform holds the required statutory license and has no CBO restriction on its banking relationships.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose mandatory export proceeds surrender or statutory mandatory conversion ratios. Export receipts must be repatriated through a CBO-licensed bank, credited to a resident Omani account in a freely convertible foreign currency or converted to OMR at the prevailing market rate. For a P2P micro-lending platform, export proceeds are not a primary source of liquidity; no surrender timeline therefore applies. Where lending funds originate from cross-border capital contributions, the only applicable rule is the general CBO/AML requirement to identify and record the inward SWIFT payment and retain supporting board resolutions and investment license records.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account with International Correspondent Connectivity

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low to conditional medium. A cross-border or offshore electronic money institution (EMI) is not authorized to open depository accounts or hold client funds in Oman. It may supply payment initiation, card acquiring, or wallet infrastructure only through a CBO-licensed payment service provider or a local commercial bank acting as the settlement bank. The EMI would be classified as a foreign-designated non-financial business and subjected to enhanced due diligence. Legal viability is therefore dependent on a documented agent/custodian arrangement with an Omani licensed institution and approval of the CBO fintech or payment services framework; a fully independent direct clearing presence is not permissible.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a high-risk non-resident SPC operating a micro-lending platform, Omani tier-1 banks will require at least one authorized signatory and, in most cases, the ultimate beneficial owner or a board-designated senior officer to attend a face-to-face onboarding interview at the bank's head office or main branch. The interview covers business model, source of funds, intended transaction volumes, and AML/CTF systems. Remote opening is generally not permitted where the borrower-facing platform is classified as high risk; video KYC may be accepted only as a supplement after physical identity verification of the directors at the local bank or an embassy/official notary. A local compliance sponsor or independent director is often necessary to accelerate onboarding but does not replace the statutory identification of the beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Banking-sector red flag: unlicensed lending or quasi-deposit-taking business model associated with P2P micro-lending platforms.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the statutory license or fintech sandbox authorization under the CBO or the applicable Omani non-bank lending framework, the company's legal opinion confirming that the platform does not take deposits, the approved set of lending algorithms and underwriting policies, AML/CFT compliance manual, borrower verification procedures, and evidence that funds are always held in segregated escrow accounts rather than platform treasury.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity in an offshore holding chain above the Oman SPC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the SPC share register and the Commercial Companies Law registration certificate, declarations from every shareholder, a full beneficial ownership map with passport copies and proof of address, no bearer shares undertaking, audited parent company financials, and a board resolution confirming that share transfers require bank notification. Use the CBO-prescribed beneficial ownership form and ensure the UBO's national ID and tax number are not redacted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear economic purpose of high-frequency cross-border inbound wires from multiple consortium or venture-capital investors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a notarized share subscription and investment agreement, a comprehensive business plan with projected loan-book growth, board resolutions authorizing each capital contribution, source-of-funds documentation from each investor bank account, proof of tax registration in the home jurisdiction where applicable, and a flow-of-funds diagram showing the settlement rail from investor to CBO-licensed bank escrow and then to the regulated operational account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction or sanctions/negative-news exposure of borrowers, payment facilitators, or intermediary wallet providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a sanctions screening report on all counterparties, an adverse-media due diligence report generated within 30 days, geographic exclusion rules excluding sanctioned jurisdictions, a blockchain/payment traceability attestation covering any crypto-to-fiat conversion, and the platform's transaction monitoring procedures meeting CBO expectations on unusual transaction reporting.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound investment equity must be remitted through SWIFT MT103 from the investor's regulated bank to the SPC's CBO-licensed settlement bank. The wire reference field must identify the legal basis and purpose, for example 'SHARE CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION — OMAN SPC — FOREIGN CAPITAL INVESTMENT LAW / COMMERCIAL COMPANIES LAW', together with the SPC's investment license number and the bank's internal reference. Oman does not require a prior CBO exchange control approval, but the receiving bank must archive the underlying investor identification, source of funds, board resolution, and final share register entry. The funds are then credited to the capital escrow account and released to the operating account only after the compliance officer confirms that the stated purpose matches the licensed financial activity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational disbursements to Omani borrowers, use the national electronic clearing system, ACH direct-debit schemes, and locally licensed wallet rails, with funds remaining in OMR. Cross-border trade disbursements for platform technology, software, or third-party services must be settled through SWIFT MT103 or, where correspondent banks require cover, MT202 COV, with the underlying agreement and Omani tax documentation attached. Commercial letters of credit are permitted under UCP600 for procurement of physical assets and banking infrastructure equipment. Any cross-border remittance made for service fees must be classified with the proper purpose code and supported by a service agreement and invoice so that withholding tax obligations are evidenced at the Omani Tax Authority level. The platform must not use personal consumer accounts or crypto-wallet providers as the clearing rail for outbound loan funding.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/OMR outright forwards with CBO-licensed banks
Cross-currency swaps between OMR and USD for refinancing of external shareholder loans
Vanilla interest-rate swaps layered onto fixed-rate loan portfolios where the underlying exposure is authenticated
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in OMR are not recognized as locally permissible due to the fixed exchange-rate peg; only genuine hedging forwards documented by the licensed Omani bank are acceptable

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial licence renewal (renewable commercial registration certificate)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — InvestEasy e-licensing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: on or before the licence expiry date shown on the e-licence (normally 12 months from issue date); no statutory grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operation after expiry constitutes unlicensed trading; MoCIIP imposes administrative fines under the Commercial Companies Law and may suspend the licence; sustained non-renewal permits administrative strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return of audited financial statements filed with the Commercial Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registration Department — annual corporate return module
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months from the financial year-end (by 30 April for a 31 December FYE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties and administrative fines per the MoCIIP enforcement schedule; repeated default may lead to licence suspension and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (unified self-assessment return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — Himam e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year (by 30 April for a 31 December tax year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative late-filing fine and monthly late-payment interest under the Unified Tax Law; escalation to forced assessment and licence restrictions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-ownership (UBO) update and declaration with mandatory register maintenance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Corporate Register (UBO module) and the company's registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due with the annual licence renewal; any shareholding transfer or UBO change must also be reported within 10 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under the Beneficial Ownership Implementing Rules (MoCIIP Decision No. 383/2021); failure to disclose subjects responsible officers to fines and potential administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) membership annual subscription renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: OCCI (processed through the MoCIIP InvestEasy portal as a precondition for licence renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Coincident with the annual commercial licence renewal (licence anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal causes rejection of the commercial licence renewal application; continued trading is unlicensed and subject to fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory supervisory return for the special P2P / micro-lending licence (prudential and AML/CFT return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) and/or Capital Market Authority (CMA) per the applicable special lending licence conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: As specified in the licence conditions, typically within 30 to 90 days after the financial year-end; exact date set by regulator circular
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Regulatory penalty, licence suspension and potential revocation of the special lending licence, terminating the platform's statutory authority to operate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all Omani Single Person Companies without turnover or capital exemption: the Commercial Companies Law requires every LLC/SPC to appoint a licensed auditor and file audited financial statements. Regulated P2P / micro-lending entities are additionally subject to CBO/CMA audit and surveillance requirements regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB and recognised by the Commercial Registrar and the Omani Capital Market Authority; no separate Omani GAAP applies to corporate statutory reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every SPC must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office and record any shareholding transfer or UBO change within 10 days. The annual UBO confirmation is submitted to MoCIIP together with the commercial licence renewal; the confirmation must identify each individual holding 10% or more direct or indirect ownership or exercising control by other means, with supporting documentation retained on file.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400–1,200 per annum in Muscat for licensed registered-office and corporate agency services including local compliance facilitation.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000–15,000 per annum for a certified external audit of a fintech SPC with lending-line disclosures and CBO/CMA regulatory reporting.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% on taxable income exceeding OMR 100,000; 0% on the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income (Income Tax Law promulgated by Royal Decree 21/2025, effective for tax years beginning on or after 1 January 2025).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday for fintech micro-lending. De facto incentive: OMR 0-100,000 taxable band at 0% (approximately USD 260,000). Exemptions: qualifying dividends received from Omani companies are 100% tax-exempt; capital gains on disposal of qualifying Omani equity holdings may be exempt. Standard deductions: tax depreciation on IT infrastructure and hardware per the capital allowance schedule; specific bad debts actually written off are deductible, whereas general IFRS 9 expected credit loss provisions are non-deductible.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Oman Annual Income Tax Return for Legal Persons - Income Tax Declaration (Form CT-1 equivalent), e-filed through the Oman Tax Authority electronic filing portal at portal.tax.gov.om using the taxpayer's TPIN; paper filing at Secretariat General of Taxation service counters is accepted for transitional cases.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (12-month fiscal period aligned to audited financial statements; the first tax period of a newly incorporated SPC may be less than 12 months).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., for a 31 December year-end, filing is due by 30 April of the following year); the Tax Authority may grant a one-time extension of up to 2 months upon application made before the due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the SPC as registered in the Commercial Register, Commercial Registration (CR) number, TPIN, share capital, country of the foreign parent, and tax residence declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Omani SPC exact CR name and TPIN; append a shareholder schedule showing the non-resident beneficial owner with name, country of tax residence, and shareholding percentage. The return is filed by the Omani entity; the non-resident shareholder does not file separately in Oman.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year start and end dates (e.g., 01/01/2025 to 31/12/2025) and reporting currency in OMR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the period covered by the audited financial statements; all foreign currency amounts must be converted to OMR at the Central Bank of Oman mid-rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All Oman-source revenue: gross loan-book interest, underwriting and arrangement fees, late-payment charges, platform service fees, and e-wallet ancillary income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Revenue cannot be reduced by interposing algorithms, payment routing, or group contracts abroad; the full economic income of the Omani licensed lending platform is assessable in Oman.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Cost of Sales / Direct Platform Costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of booking and servicing micro-loans: cloud hosting fees (subject to transfer pricing review), credit-scoring API costs, payment gateway fees, customer support personnel, origination, and collection costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses economically incurred for the Omani business, supported by invoices retained in Oman, are deductible; cross-border group charges must satisfy the arm's length standard and the 10% withholding obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Operating, Administrative, and Financing Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employee salaries, rent, Central Bank of Oman licensing and AML compliance costs, statutory audit, legal fees, and interest on eligible arm's length debt.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest to foreign lenders is deductible only at an arm's length rate and within thin-capitalization limits; payments to non-residents for management fees and royalties trigger 10% withholding tax at source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Net Accounting Profit Before Tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit or loss per the audited financial statements prepared under IFRS.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The audited statements must cover the SPC's entire lending activity; the audit report is a mandatory attachment and must not exclude wallet-payout operations or off-balance-sheet loan origination.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General provisions (IFRS 9 expected credit loss provisions), unrealized foreign exchange losses, fines, penalties, bribes, non-qualifying entertainment, excess interest, and disallowed management fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All add-backs must be computed line-by-line; understatement of non-deductible provisions is a common audit target in consumer-lending platforms.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax depreciation per the legal capital allowance schedule, specific bad debts actually written off, donations to Omani charities within limits, 100% exempt dividends from Omani entities, and exempt gains on qualifying Omani share disposals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exemptions are available only if the SPC holds the required ownership thresholds and supporting documentation; dividends distributed to the foreign shareholder are not taxed again at shareholder level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted tax losses of prior periods (maximum 5 years) set off against current taxable income; loss carryforward is forfeited if more than 51% of shares change ownership without business continuity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a loss reconciliation schedule showing each loss year and the ownership condition; non-resident share transfers must be documented to preserve the carryforward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net adjusted taxable income after add-backs, deductions, and loss set-offs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This figure is the basis for the 0% and 15% rate bands; an SPC cannot carve out income to fall below the OMR 100,000 threshold when the economic substance test demonstrates a wider business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the progressive schedule: first OMR 100,000 of taxable income at 0%; taxable income above OMR 100,000 at 15%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 0% band is applied to the SPC's own taxable income only; profits split among multiple related Omani SPVs are not aggregated for the band, but general anti-avoidance rules may consolidate artificial splits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 12 - Tax Payable / Prepayments / Balance Due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due after payments on account, withholding credits, and installments; the payment deadline coincides with the filing deadline.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign shareholder cannot extend the Omani payment deadline; late payment accrues 1% per month, capped at 25% of the assessed tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Under Royal Decree 21/2025: late filing - 1% of assessed tax per month or part thereof, capped at 25%; late payment - 1% per month, capped at 25%; negligent or inaccurate returns - OMR 200 to OMR 1,000 per schedule. Legacy regime under Royal Decree 28/2009: fixed OMR 100 plus OMR 10 per day of delay, capped at OMR 1,000. Failure to attach audited statements or transfer pricing schedules blocks the assessment and triggers automatic best-of-judgment assessment.
